status: exploratory development fixed before new inference
scope: All 24 previously inspected active QA-SRL events; grammatical subject/object, NOT verified semantic roles. No sealed data, no optimization.
prediction: If output contract explains the old gain, explicit participant-only instruction and/or Answer prefix improve direct subject accuracy more than object accuracy and narrow the blind-routing discrepancy. Failure to improve weakens this account. Prompt gains alone do not isolate internal representation.
primary_contrast: Within-event instruction x requested-role risk difference averaged across prefixes, plus every factorial cell. No significance-based selection or progression.
secondary: Prefix x role; joint answers per event; label-based content diagnostics, exact span F1; constrained two-gold-participant sequence likelihood as oracle diagnostic only; historical raw baseline reproducibility.
limits: One small checkpoint and reused 24 events; no new population or semantic generalization claim.
Different instructions change attention as well as format; no exclusive mechanism identification.
Likelihood candidate set uses gold spans and is not autonomous QA; token normalization may alter choice.
